product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle helps product, eCommerce, marketing, and engineering teams quantify digital friction’s impact on revenue and prioritize improvements to customer journeys.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage directly describes connecting digital friction to revenue and names product, eCommerce, marketing, and engineering teams as the users who decide what to fix next. Source: https://bluetriangle.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The public Choose Your Plan page lists an Enterprise plan with custom pricing; numerical prices are not required under the question’s definition. Source: https://portal.bluetriangle.com/btportal/web/index.php?r=checkout%2Fpackage.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage’s trusted-enterprise-brands section explicitly names The Home Depot and Zales. Source: https://www.bluetriangle.com/. | named_customers.0: The Home Depot appears in the homepage’s trusted-brands section. Source: https://www.bluetriangle.com/. | named_customers.1: Zales appears in the homepage’s trusted-brands section. Source: https://www.bluetriangle.com/.

employee_band.notes: This company profile explicitly lists 21–50 employees. Other reviewed profiles use the broader 11–50 range, so the narrower band relies on this third-party estimate. Source: https://prospeo.io/c/blue-triangle-revenue.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: LinkedIn explicitly lists Glen Allen as headquarters, and the company contact page gives a matching Glen Allen address. These are preferred over profiles listing Mechanicsville. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/blue-triangle-technologies/jobs and https://bluetriangle.com/contact-us. | hq_country: LinkedIn identifies the headquarters as Glen Allen, Virginia, and the company profile places its Cox Road address in the United States. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/blue-triangle-technologies/jobs and https://prospeo.io/c/blue-triangle-revenue.

founded_year.notes: The company profile identifies bluetriangle.com and records a founding year of 2011. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/bluetriangle/__vIFw5K-i90KZxLyK80ylssSFTqdpkXKWH6BovW31hZQ.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index contains product announcements, marketing, business commentary, and general performance advice—not two engineer-authored explanations of how Blue Triangle builds its own product. Source: https://bluetriangle.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index links multiple documentation sections, including Getting Started, API documentation, SDK documentation, data collection, and the MCP server. Source: https://help.bluetriangle.com/help-center/documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current jobs listing reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026, and Wellfound also lists no jobs. Consequently, neither board lists a qualifying AI/ML/data-science role. Sources: https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/blue-triangle and https://wellfound.com/company/blue-triangle-technologies.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model provider was identified in the reviewed Assistant AI documentation, security documentation, privacy policy, subprocessor list, or blog. The MCP announcement names compatible external assistants, which does not establish the provider powering Blue Triangle’s built-in AI. Sources: https://help.bluetriangle.com/hc/en-us/articles/52815377375123-Assistant-AI-Overview; https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/Blue_Triangle_June_2023/pdf/Blue%20Triangle%20Subprocessor%20List%202023.pdf; https://bluetriangle.com/blog/blue-triangle-mcp-ai-assistant-access.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Legal & Trust Center offers an SOC-2 report and ISO27001 documentation on request, without describing either as in progress. Only those two claims from this page are included. Source: https://bluetriangle.com/legal-trust. | compliance_certs.0: The trust page offers an SOC-2 report. Source: https://bluetriangle.com/legal-trust. | compliance_certs.1: The trust page explicitly names ISO27001 documentation. Source: https://bluetriangle.com/legal-trust.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: LeadIQ explicitly labels the November 9, 2021 round Series B. Another profile labels it generically as Venture, so the specific stage rests on LeadIQ. Source: https://leadiq.com/c/blue-triangle/5a1d847824000024005ef211. | funding_date: Two funding profiles identify November 2021 as the most recent round; one specifies November 9. Older funding records end in 2015, but these profiles report the later round. Sources: https://leadiq.com/c/blue-triangle/5a1d847824000024005ef211 and https://millionrounds.com/company/blue-triangle. | funding_amount_usd: The latest November 2021 round is listed with an undisclosed amount. The separately reported $8.2 million is cumulative funding, not the amount of that round, so the round amount remains unknown. Sources: https://millionrounds.com/company/blue-triangle and https://leadiq.com/c/blue-triangle/5a1d847824000024005ef211.

raised_18mo.notes: Both profiles place the latest funding in November 2021, before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025. Sources: https://millionrounds.com/company/blue-triangle and https://leadiq.com/c/blue-triangle/5a1d847824000024005ef211.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current jobs listing reports no open roles, and the discovered SDR posting explicitly no longer accepts applications. Sources: https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/blue-triangle and https://careers.saasventurecapital.com/companies/blue-triangle/jobs/28126921-sales-development-representative.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 2026 announcement introduces MCP access to Blue Triangle data, a substantive new capability within the six-month window. Source: https://bluetriangle.com/blog/blue-triangle-mcp-ai-assistant-access.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page identifies the current roster but provides no appointment dates. Profile research did not establish a qualifying company arrival or departure during the window; a January 2026 boundary in Emily Salzer’s profile did not establish that she joined or left the company. The available evidence is insufficient for a reliable true or false. Source: https://bluetriangle.com/company.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The SDR job description mentions Outreach.io, Salesloft, HubSpot, and ZoomInfo. These are historical recruiting signals, not confirmation that all four remain deployed; the posting is closed.
